card.title: 174th INDEPENDENT
card.text: After this unit attacks the enemy HQ, it gets +1+1 and you draw a card.
card.flavorText: The 174th Independent Battalion was a unit of the 102nd Division of the Imperial Japanese Army. The division was formed in 1944 as a security division, which meant that it was mainly composed of independent infantry battalions instead of regiments. The division was transferred to the Philippines where part of the division fought against the US forces in the Battle of Leyte and the Battle of the Visayas. Afterwards some sub-units managed to hold out in mountainous regions until Japan's surrender on August 15th, 1945. During the Invasion of Palawan in March-April 1945, two battalions of the 102nd Division were defeated by the US 186th Regimental Combat Team. On Panay, a single company from the division retreated to the mountains and remained relatively intact. On Cebu, the 102nd Division consisted of a single battalion and survivors from Leyte. They suffered heavy casualties during the Battle for Cebu City but managed to continue guerrilla warfare after the battle. On Negros island, approximately 4,000 personnel from the 77th Infantry Brigade of the 102nd Division also survived and engaged in guerrilla warfare against invading US forces from March 1945 until the end of the war.
